key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 1 of 2)[a2]/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 1 of 2)[a2].adf:frontend:0:286E
name: blit_copy_between_buffers
description: Waits for the blitter to go idle, then copies one fixed-size rectangle from a source buffer to a destination buffer with a full word mask and no modulo. Before the copy it calls a routine held in the same table.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 1 of 2)[a2]/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 1 of 2)[a2].adf:frontend:0:3D36
name: navigate_menu_selection
description: Reads eight 34-byte slot records and moves a cursor up or down on input flags. It copies the selected slot's fields into a result block and redraws through blitter copies and indirect routine calls.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 1 of 2)[a2]/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 1 of 2)[a2].adf:frontend:0:3EE6
name: stub_bad_instruction_data
description: Only two instructions here are real code; the rest is a gap between routines that the disassembler decoded as instructions. It has no confirmed caller and no confirmed behaviour.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 1 of 2)[a2]/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 1 of 2)[a2].adf:frontend:0:3EEC
name: run_entry_selection_loop
description: Runs a loop that moves a cursor over eight 34-byte entries on input flags, and when a choice is confirmed copies that entry's fields into a result block. The routine references the text '2nd Lt.' and calls the same blit and indirect routines as its neighbours.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 1 of 2)[a2]/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 1 of 2)[a2].adf:frontend:0:4092
name: run_hall_of_fame_menu
description: Loops over input flags to move a cursor across 34-byte entries and returns the chosen entry, copying its fields into a result area. It references the text 'HALLFAME' and calls indirect routines to draw each step.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 1 of 2)[a2]/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 1 of 2)[a2].adf:frontend:0:414A
name: draw_eight_menu_rows
description: Loops eight times over a table of 34-byte rows, advancing a row pointer and a row index, and calls the drawing routine for each row.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 1 of 2)[a2]/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 1 of 2)[a2].adf:frontend:0:4186
name: draw_centered_flagged_items
description: Sums the widths of the set bits in a 16-bit field from a record, centres the resulting run horizontally, and draws each set item in turn. It calls several drawing and text routines to do this.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 1 of 2)[a2]/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 1 of 2)[a2].adf:frontend:0:4274
name: draw_text_twice_for_highlight
description: Clears a per-row state byte and calls a draw routine, then sets the byte to a nonzero value and calls the same routine again. The text is therefore drawn in two passes, one normal and one highlighted.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 1 of 2)[a2]/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 1 of 2)[a2].adf:frontend:0:42F8
name: fade_palette_entries_down
description: Steps 24 colour entries down by one unit in each of the red, green and blue channels per pass, copying each pass to a second table. It repeats for five passes and calls an indirect routine twice per pass.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 1 of 2)[a2]/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 1 of 2)[a2].adf:frontend:0:4348
name: blit_masked_sprite_rectangle
description: Waits for the blitter, then sets up a masked blit from a source block into the destination. It programs the source, mask and destination pointers, the first and last word masks, the modulos and the blit size.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 1 of 2)[a2]/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 1 of 2)[a2].adf:frontend:0:43CE
name: insert_sorted_table_entry
description: Compares a new 32-bit value against eight sorted 34-byte entries to find its insertion slot. It shifts the lower entries down, writes the new entry into the gap, and copies a block of 273 words and stops when an earlier call returns zero. The text HALLFAME appears in its references.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 1 of 2)[a2]/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 1 of 2)[a2].adf:frontend:0:44C0
name: run_pulsing_selection_menu
description: Runs a five-item menu loop in which up and down move the selection and fire returns the chosen index into a shared block. Each frame it steps a 12-bit colour value in equal red, green and blue increments, bounces it between limits, and writes it to a shared word.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 1 of 2)[a2]/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 1 of 2)[a2].adf:frontend:0:45C4
name: run_pulsing_selection_menu
description: Runs the same five-item pulsing selection loop as its neighbour, with the same input handling and colour stepping, and returns the chosen index through the shared block when a selection is made.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 1 of 2)[a2]/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 1 of 2)[a2].adf:frontend:0:47D0
name: enter_pulsing_selection_menu
description: The disassembly records a single instruction at this entry, and the decompiled body is the same pulsing selection-menu loop as its neighbours. It is therefore treated as a jump into that shared loop.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 1 of 2)[a2]/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 1 of 2)[a2].adf:frontend:0:47D4
name: run_pulsing_menu_palette_update
description: Runs the pulsing selection loop of its neighbours and also writes a colour register on each frame, the register being COLOR16. The selection index is returned through the shared block when a choice is made.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 1 of 2)[a2]/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 1 of 2)[a2].adf:frontend:0:4AA6
name: run_grid_pulsing_menu
description: Runs a six-item selection grid in which up and down move the selection by three and left and right by one, returning the index when fire is pressed. It pulses a colour register like its neighbours and draws each item from a 12-byte-per-entry table.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 1 of 2)[a2]/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 1 of 2)[a2].adf:frontend:0:4D86
name: redraw_selection_if_moved
description: Compares the current selection coordinates with the previously drawn ones, and when they differ and a flag is set, waits for the blitter and copies a fixed rectangle. It then stores the current coordinates as the drawn ones and clears the dirty flags.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 1 of 2)[a2]/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 1 of 2)[a2].adf:frontend:0:4EB8
name: enter_blit_draw_sequence
description: The disassembly records a single instruction at this entry. The decompiled body waits for the blitter, sets the copy registers, and then makes a fixed sequence of calls to drawing routines through the same table, so this entry is treated as a jump into that sequence.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 1 of 2)[a2]/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 1 of 2)[a2].adf:frontend:0:4EBC
name: blit_then_draw_row_sequence
description: Waits for the blitter, sets up a copy from the buffer, and then makes a fixed sequence of calls to drawing routines through the table in three batches. It ends with two further calls, and the batches are separated by calls to a routine held in the same table.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 1 of 2)[a2]/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 1 of 2)[a2].adf:frontend:0:5036
name: append_text_string_to_buffer
description: Looks up a text pointer from a table using a 7-bit index held in a record and appends it to a global text buffer. It appends a second string first when a flag is set, and it returns without writing when the looked-up text is empty.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 1 of 2)[a2]/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 1 of 2)[a2].adf:frontend:0:5096
name: draw_text_with_two_colours
description: Sets a per-draw colour byte and calls a drawing routine, then sets a second colour byte and calls the same routine again. One item is therefore drawn in two colours.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 1 of 2)[a2]/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 1 of 2)[a2].adf:frontend:0:50D0
name: find_next_selectable_entry
description: Walks a list of linked entries, skipping any with certain flag bits set, and selects the next valid entry by its stored position. It records the previous coordinates and reloads the active handler from a lookup table.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 1 of 2)[a2]/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 1 of 2)[a2].adf:frontend:0:5184
name: find_smallest_valued_entry
description: Scans a table of 50-byte entries, skipping flagged ones, and keeps the entry with the smallest 16-bit value. It copies that entry's pointer into the output block and returns the flag word of the last entry checked.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 1 of 2)[a2]/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 1 of 2)[a2].adf:frontend:0:51D0
name: pick_unflagged_entry_index
description: Repeatedly takes a value from a routine and maps it through a lookup table to an entry in a 50-byte table, retrying until the entry's flag bits are clear. It stores the chosen index in one of two shared words, selected by a parameter.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 1 of 2)[a2]/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 1 of 2)[a2].adf:frontend:0:529E
name: pick_entry_with_flag_pattern
description: Repeatedly takes a value from a routine and maps it to an entry in a 50-byte table, retrying until the entry's flag bits match a required pattern. It returns the matching entry's index together with its flags.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 1 of 2)[a2]/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 1 of 2)[a2].adf:frontend:0:52CE
name: format_coordinate_digits_text
description: Converts two scaled position values into decimal digits by repeated subtraction of ten, then writes the digit characters into a fixed text buffer.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 1 of 2)[a2]/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 1 of 2)[a2].adf:frontend:0:5346
name: find_or_register_position_entry
description: Searches a table of 50-byte records for one matching the given position and returns its index if found. If none matches, it stores the position in the next free record, looks up that record's text, and returns the new index.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 1 of 2)[a2]/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 1 of 2)[a2].adf:frontend:0:534C
name: enter_position_entry_lookup
description: The disassembly records two instructions at this entry, and the decompiled body is the same position-lookup routine as its neighbour, so this entry is treated as a jump into that shared lookup.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 1 of 2)[a2]/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 1 of 2)[a2].adf:frontend:0:544C
name: copy_indexed_record_block
description: If the index is below 24, copies a block of 380 records from the indexed source into the destination at a 20-byte stride, moving three 32-bit values per record. Where the disassembly records a single instruction, the decompiled body is this same copy loop.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 1 of 2)[a2]/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 1 of 2)[a2].adf:frontend:0:5450
name: copy_indexed_record_block
description: Copies a block of 380 records from the source selected by the index into the destination at a 20-byte stride, moving three 32-bit values per record, and does nothing when the index is 24 or above. The disassembly records a single instruction here, and the decompiled body matches the copy loop of its neighbours.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 1 of 2)[a2]/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 1 of 2)[a2].adf:frontend:0:5454
name: copy_indexed_record_block
description: Copies a block of 380 records from the source selected by the index into the destination at a 20-byte stride, moving three 32-bit values per record, and does nothing when the index is 24 or above. The routine is called from one place.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 1 of 2)[a2]/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 1 of 2)[a2].adf:frontend:0:54DC
name: copy_state_block_into_tables
description: Copies a block of scalar fields from a source structure into working variables, then copies several large tables of 50-byte and 4-byte entries into fixed working buffers. Finally it fills one table by adding each 16-bit value to a base value.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 1 of 2)[a2]/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 1 of 2)[a2].adf:frontend:0:558C
name: fetch_block_with_timeout
description: When the selected index has changed, it requests a buffer from the operating system library and waits up to a fixed timeout for data before copying the received fields and tables into working storage.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 1 of 2)[a2]/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 1 of 2)[a2].adf:frontend:0:565E
name: copy_received_block_into_tables
description: Copies a received block of scalar fields, 50-byte table entries and 4-byte table entries into working storage, as its neighbour does, after a single library call. The data layout matches the copy routine next to it.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 1 of 2)[a2]/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 1 of 2)[a2].adf:frontend:0:2BCF0
name: draw_line_with_blitter
description: Computes the screen address and octant of a line between two points, then programs the blitter in line mode and issues four line blits, advancing the destination address by a fixed row stride each time. It returns early when a flag is nonzero.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 1 of 2)[a2]/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 1 of 2)[a2].adf:frontend:0:2BD12
name: draw_masked_blitter_line_segments
description: Programs the blitter for a line between two points, with the octant derived from comparing the coordinates, and issues four blits. Each blit takes its pixel bit from a mask that is shifted by one per step.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 1 of 2)[a2]/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 1 of 2)[a2].adf:frontend:0:2BDDA
name: merge_adjacent_coordinate_runs
description: Walks an index list of coordinate records and writes a merged output list, combining neighbouring entries whose endpoints match and tracking the lowest and highest values. The decompiled output is truncated, so the exact merge rule is not fully recovered.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 1 of 2)[a2]/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 1 of 2)[a2].adf:frontend:0:2CD16
name: dispatch_line_octant_handler
description: Compares the x and y deltas between two points, records a direction code and step pair in the output list, then jumps through a table of line-step handlers chosen by the length of the major axis.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 1 of 2)[a2]/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 1 of 2)[a2].adf:frontend:0:2CDD4
name: stub_bad_instruction_data
description: Decoded from a gap that the disassembler could not place: the listing is a long unrolled run of subtract-with-carry stores, which is most likely table data rather than a routine. No behaviour is confirmed.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 1 of 2)[a2]/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 1 of 2)[a2].adf:frontend:0:2D15A
name: populate_arithmetic_sequence
description: Writes an unrolled run of 16-bit values into a buffer, each one equal to the previous value plus a constant and a carry bit, so the buffer holds an arithmetic progression. It is straight-line code with no loop.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 1 of 2)[a2]/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 1 of 2)[a2].adf:frontend:0:2D48C
name: enter_span_clear_rows
description: The disassembly records a single instruction at this entry, and the decompiled body is the same span-clearing routine as its neighbour. It is therefore treated as a jump into that shared body.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 1 of 2)[a2]/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 1 of 2)[a2].adf:frontend:0:2D490
name: clear_bitplane_span_rows
description: For each row in a block, takes a pair of x values from two arrays and, when the first is at or before the second, clears the bits between them in the bitplane using edge masks from a 16-entry table. It uses a blitter copy for longer spans, and rows with an inverted range are skipped.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 1 of 2)[a2]/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 1 of 2)[a2].adf:frontend:0:2D58C
name: clear_spans_and_queue_blits
description: For each row, clears the bits between pairs of x values using edge masks, and for longer spans writes a blitter descriptor into a list holding the row address, width and mask. It is the clearing counterpart of the span-setting routines.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 1 of 2)[a2]/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 1 of 2)[a2].adf:frontend:0:2D5D2
name: clear_spans_and_queue_blits
description: Variant that clears the first row before entering the same span loop, then writes blitter descriptors into the list for longer spans. It uses the same edge-mask table as its neighbour.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 1 of 2)[a2]/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 1 of 2)[a2].adf:frontend:0:2D648
name: set_bitplane_span_rows
description: For each row, sets the bits between pairs of x values in the bitplane using edge masks from a 16-entry table, with a blitter copy for longer spans. Rows whose range is inverted are skipped.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 1 of 2)[a2]/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 1 of 2)[a2].adf:frontend:0:2D744
name: set_spans_and_queue_blits
description: Sets the bits between pairs of x values row by row, and for longer spans writes a blitter descriptor with the row address, width and mask into a list. It is the setting counterpart of the clearing routines.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 1 of 2)[a2]/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 1 of 2)[a2].adf:frontend:0:2D78A
name: set_spans_and_queue_blits
description: Sets the bits between pairs of x values across the interleaved bitplanes row by row, and for longer spans writes a blitter descriptor into a list. It is one of the span-setting variants that differ only in which bitplane offsets they touch.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 1 of 2)[a2]/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 1 of 2)[a2].adf:frontend:0:2D800
name: set_bitplane_span_rows
description: Sets bits between pairs of x values in the interleaved bitplanes, row by row, using edge masks from a 16-entry table and a blitter copy for longer spans. It touches a different bitplane offset from its neighbours, and inverted ranges are skipped.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 1 of 2)[a2]/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 1 of 2)[a2].adf:frontend:0:2D8FC
name: set_spans_and_queue_blits
description: Sets bits between pairs of x values row by row across the interleaved bitplanes, writing a blitter descriptor for longer spans. It is the same routine as its neighbours, entered at a different bitplane offset.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 1 of 2)[a2]/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 1 of 2)[a2].adf:frontend:0:2D942
name: set_spans_and_queue_blits
description: Entered directly at the span-setting step, it sets bits between pairs of x values and writes a blitter descriptor for longer spans into the list. It shares its loop with the other span-setting routines.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 1 of 2)[a2]/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 1 of 2)[a2].adf:frontend:0:2D9B8
name: fill_spans_with_plane_pattern
description: For each row, fills the span between two x values across the interleaved bitplanes using edge masks, setting some planes and clearing others in the same pass. Longer spans are copied with the blitter.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 1 of 2)[a2]/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 1 of 2)[a2].adf:frontend:0:2DAB4
name: fill_spans_and_queue_blits
description: Fills spans between pairs of x values row by row with a per-plane pattern, and for longer spans writes a blitter descriptor into a list. It is the queued variant of the plane-pattern fill.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 1 of 2)[a2]/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 1 of 2)[a2].adf:frontend:0:2DAFA
name: fill_spans_and_queue_blits
description: Entered directly at the span-fill step, it fills spans between pairs of x values with a per-plane pattern and writes a blitter descriptor for longer spans. It shares its loop with the other plane-pattern fill routines.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 1 of 2)[a2]/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 1 of 2)[a2].adf:frontend:0:2DB70
name: fill_spans_with_plane_pattern
description: Fills spans between pairs of x values using a plane pattern that sets one bitplane and clears another, drawing the longer spans with a blitter copy. It differs from its neighbours in the bitplane offsets it writes.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 1 of 2)[a2]/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 1 of 2)[a2].adf:frontend:0:2DC6C
name: fill_spans_and_queue_blits
description: Fills spans between pairs of x values with a per-plane pattern across the interleaved bitplanes, and for longer spans writes a blitter descriptor into a list. It uses bitplane offsets that differ from its neighbours.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 1 of 2)[a2]/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 1 of 2)[a2].adf:frontend:0:2DCB2
name: fill_spans_and_queue_blits
description: Entered directly at the span-fill step, it fills spans with a per-plane pattern and writes a blitter descriptor for longer spans. It shares its loop with the other queued plane-pattern fills.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 1 of 2)[a2]/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 1 of 2)[a2].adf:frontend:0:2DD28
name: fill_spans_with_plane_pattern
description: For each row, fills the span between two x values with a per-plane pattern across the interleaved bitplanes, drawing longer spans with a blitter copy. It is the non-queued variant that uses a different bitplane offset.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 1 of 2)[a2]/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 1 of 2)[a2].adf:frontend:0:2DE24
name: fill_spans_and_queue_blits
description: Entered at a second span-fill step, it fills spans with a per-plane pattern and writes a blitter descriptor for longer spans into the list. It shares its loop with the other queued plane-pattern fills.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 1 of 2)[a2]/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 1 of 2)[a2].adf:frontend:0:2DE6A
name: fill_spans_and_queue_blits
description: Fills spans between pairs of x values with a per-plane pattern and, for longer spans, writes a blitter descriptor into a list. It is one of the queued plane-pattern fills and uses its own bitplane offsets.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 1 of 2)[a2]/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 1 of 2)[a2].adf:frontend:0:2DEE0
name: fill_spans_with_plane_pattern
description: For each row, fills the span between two x values with a per-plane pattern across the interleaved bitplanes, drawing longer spans with a blitter copy. It is the non-queued variant with a different plane offset set.
